mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which directly supports corporate revenue streams and earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.8% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real borrowing costs and discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint labor market dynamics.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 45% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 109) during late-cycle expansion (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals an impending economic slowdown where equity valuations contract due to reduced corporate capital expenditure, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 55% of instances when INDPRO < 109 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% qoq) indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% qoq.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage inflation, prompting aggressive monetary policy responses that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in < 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL MoM growth > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% indicates a dual threat of inflation and rate hikes, compressing equity valuations through higher real rates and reduced risk appetite, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint monetary dynamics.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL MoM growth > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 109.5) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.
